node.statement: The direct-corner envelope supplies two distinct bounds: each nonempty P_X (in particular X=U,V,R) has projection defect at most c0*epsilon, whereas the relevant subordination and complementarity errors are at most L^0*epsilon. For projection defects, W.L>=L^0>=1, W.c0_cb=c0, W.K3>=W.c0_cb*W.L, and epsilon>=0 give c0*epsilon<=c0*W.L*epsilon<=W.K3*epsilon=t_3. For subordination/complementarity errors, L^0*epsilon<=W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R<=t_3, where the last inequality follows from W.K3>=W.L. Hence all direct-envelope projection/subordination/complementarity errors required by the Stage-3 four-corner datum are at most t_3, without asserting the false bound c0*epsilon<=L^0*epsilon.
